1365	    -- ДИАГНОСТИКА: логируем все чанки и состояние

1373	    if #chunks < 2 then

1389	    while i <= #chunks do

1400	    for si, grp in ipairs(segmentGroups) do

1512	            if effectiveLang == "auto" then

1564	local function checkSilence()
1565	    if not isRecording then return end
1566	    local chunks = getChunkFiles()
1567	    local numChunks = #chunks
1568	    -- Only check completed chunks (not the one being written)
1569	    local completed = numChunks - 1
1570	    if completed <= lastCheckedChunk then return end
1571	
1572	    -- Check the latest completed chunk
1573	    local chunkPath = chunks[completed]
1574	    lastCheckedChunk = completed
1575	
1576	    local volTask = hs.task.new(FFMPEG, function(code, out, err)
1577	        if code ~= 0 or not isRecording then return end
1578	        local maxVol = (err or ""):match("max_volume:%s*([-%.%d]+)")
1579	        if maxVol then
1580	            maxVol = tonumber(maxVol)
1581	            if maxVol and maxVol < AUTO_STOP_THRESHOLD_DB then
1582	                silentChunkCount = silentChunkCount + 1
1583	                log("silence: chunk " .. completed .. " vol=" .. maxVol .. "dB (count=" .. silentChunkCount .. ")")
1584	                if silentChunkCount >= AUTO_STOP_SILENCE_SECONDS then
1585	                    log("auto-stop: " .. AUTO_STOP_SILENCE_SECONDS .. "s of silence")
1586	                    stopRecording()
1587	                end
1588	            else
1589	                silentChunkCount = 0
1590	            end
1591	        end
1592	    end, { "-i", chunkPath, "-af", "volumedetect", "-f", "null", "-" })
1593	    volTask:start()
1594	end
